name: Wild Guardians
summary: Trull Failbane in Felwood asks you to deal with Raging and Ragged Owlbeasts in Winterspring. He wants fifteen of each killed.

sections.title: Owlbeasts of Winterspring
sections.body: The owlbeasts Trull Failbane names roam Winterspring, just beyond Timbermaw to the northeast of Felwood. Ragged Owlbeasts keep south of the road, and Raging Owlbeasts roam the center of Winterspring. He wants fifteen of each killed so the land can be explored.

faq.answer: Trull Failbane in Felwood asks you to kill Raging and Ragged Owlbeasts.
Trull wants fifteen Raging Owlbeasts and fifteen Ragged Owlbeasts killed.

faq.q: Where does Trull Failbane want this done?
faq.answer: In Winterspring, just beyond Timbermaw. Trull says the Ragged Owlbeasts are south of the road and the Raging Owlbeasts are in the center of Winterspring.
